pages.title: Negative Mass Ingot
pages.text: Matter with negative inertial mass: push it and it comes toward you. A positive and a negative mass placed side by side would chase each other forever. The ingot is strangely cooperative, sliding into my hand whenever I try to push it away.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding Massless Alloy into Exotic Matter Crystal in the Higgs Field Modulator, I pushed its mass below zero. The first ingot slid uphill. Physicists predicted it decades ago; it was still alarming.
